description: Which Japanese corporate numbers could this company name refer to? Searches gBizINFO (METI) by name (partial match), optionally within a prefecture, and returns every candidate with corporate number, name and address, marked exact_name or fuzzy_candidate. Never picks one for you: all candidate numbers are returned with total and truncated. Carries the gBizINFO source notice. Not an official result.

address_hint.description: Optional part of the address (e.g. 千代田区霞が関). Candidates whose published address contains it are listed first; no candidate is dropped.

limit.description: Number of candidates to detail, 1-50 (default 20). candidate_corporate_numbers always lists all of them (up to 200).

name.description: Company name in Japanese or English, 2-100 characters, e.g. 経済産業省 or a company name. gBizINFO matches it as a partial name.

prefecture.description: Optional prefecture code 01-47 (e.g. 13) or name (Tokyo or 東京都) to narrow the search to head offices in that prefecture.

name: gbizinfo_resolve_corporate_number

attribution.description: Required source notice (gBizINFO terms of use; notice_ja is the required wording, notice_ja_with_date adds the retrieval date) and the statement that this is processed by MK Career Planning and is not an official government result. Keep it when you pass results on.

candidate_corporate_numbers.description: Every candidate's corporate number, including those not detailed in candidates (never collapsed to one).

provenance.description: Freshness receipts for every upstream source used.

items.description: Freshness receipt for one upstream source.

fetch_status.description: found / empty / stale / unavailable / unsupported (see catalog fetch_status_values).

retrieved_at.description: When this service retrieved the upstream data (null if unknown).

source.description: Publisher and URL of the upstream document or dataset.

upstream_updated_at.description: Update time stated by the upstream, or null when it states none.

status.description: candidates_found / no_candidates_found / unknown (see unknown_reason). A failure is never reported as no candidates.

terms.description: URL of the terms of service.

total.description: Number of candidates gBizINFO returned (a lower bound when total_is_lower_bound).

title: Corporate number candidates for a company name (gBizINFO)
